operation.body:
## Goal
Prepare the call-level public telemetry adapter and isolation review needed before live discovery implementation. Deliver one documentation-only PR with exact candidate APIs, field allowlists, ownership/failure handling, bounded worker design and a concrete fixture/owner validation sequence.

## Acceptance criteria
- Inspect primary Apple API/source evidence and installed SDK declarations without executing telemetry. Pin reviewed source revisions, distinguish SDK/source evidence from verified Monterey runtime compatibility, and record any uncertain mappings.
- Specify the smallest public-source adapter allowlist for hardware/OS inventory, aggregate CPU ticks, thermal-pressure category and AC/battery context. For each, enumerate exact allowed calls/arguments/output fields, native ownership/length/type checks, status mapping and privacy exclusions. No automatic fallback, privileged source, arbitrary sysctl/driver/subprocess interface or source dumps.
- Propose a bounded unprivileged worker/request/response lifecycle and its interaction with existing SamplingSchedule, SourceFailurePolicy and CPUActivityDelta. Address deadlines, late/mismatched replies, no overlap/catch-up, cancellation, failed termination/reaping, size caps and honest incomplete/gap reporting. Do not claim guaranteed cancellation of kernel work.
- Define fixture/fake-transport and blocked-worker tests that must pass before owner-run capture; separate remaining secure output persistence, native implementation and operation-specific target-device approval. Keep phase-1/fan/temperature/GPU/performance gaps explicit.
- Update development/specification/architecture pointers as needed, keeping accepted R-001 constraints distinct from this detailed proposal. Storing/merging the review does not adopt a new security boundary or approve hardware tests. Complete documentation/adapter validation, integrated review, signed PR/CI and self-correcting review if eligible.

## Constraints
Parent Project #1; current local self-correcting-review auto-merge authorization. One scoped goal. Only eligible Low-risk changes may agent-squash; mandatory human review, implementation-readiness and all safety gates remain. Research/design documentation only. No product/native code, source invocation or hardware tests. Use primary sources and read-only SDK/header inspection. Exact implementation and any material boundary decision remain subject to review before affected code. Preserve reusable private workflow, historical transcription and unrelated .gitlab/.
Risks: SDK mistaken for Monterey proof, nominal thermal state misread as temperature/safety, assuming a timer cancels native work, leaking inventory/worker dumps, indefinite process reaping, design text mistaken for operation approval. Decision queue: no blocker to preparing this proposal; flag material implementation choices rather than silently approving them.

## Out of scope
Executing native/hardware/telemetry commands or tests, privilege, workloads, SMC transactions/control, product code, workers/IPC implementation, capture, persistence, dependency/toolchain/CI changes, GUI/controller/recovery, background automation and a second goal.

## Relevant context
Approved R-001 A/Y in Project #1 comment 6879220276; docs/discovery-specification.md; docs/monterey-telemetry-research.md; docs/development.md; .ai/docs/architecture-direction.md; .ai/project/; .ai/docs/project-requirements.md. Prior Goals 2,7,9,11,13,15,17 are terminal in merged PRs 3,8,10,12,14,16,18; no deferred-owner-validation markers. Main 47ae38faa16325ef9c5389dc70fdef540ea84bab and CI run 43701476348 are green. Existing pure report/reader/failure/sampling policies do not implement live collection or isolation.
Rollback: reviewed forward revert documentation PR; no deployed service, changed permission or captured data.
